database::users::user_handler_tests::wor.alias: Rejects the same username and hash
database::users::user_handler_tests::wor.expected: UsernameExists. Account 7 and ID 8 stay unchanged.

database::users::user_handler_tests::wor.alias: Rejects the same username with a different hash
database::users::user_handler_tests::wor.expected: UsernameExists. Stored hash remains "old-hash"; ID 8 stays available.

database::users::user_handler_tests::wor.alias: Accepts a new username with an existing hash

database::users::user_handler_tests::wor.expected: NotEnoughSpace. No account or profile created.
Success(7). Account 7 and its profile are gone.
WrongCredentials. Account 7 and its profile remain.

database::users::user_handler_tests::wor.alias: Continues after a dropped reply receiver
database::users::user_handler_tests::wor.input: IDs=[7,8]. Queue RegRequest("first", "first-hash"), drop its reply receiver, then queue RegRequest("second", "second-hash").
database::users::user_handler_tests::wor.expected: Both accounts are inserted. The second caller receives Success(8).

database::users::user_handler_tests::wor.input: IDs=[7], queue RegRequest("queued", "queued-hash"), then close all request senders before running the worker.
database::users::user_handler_tests::wor.expected: The caller receives Success(7) and run returns within the test timeout.

database::users::tests::insert_new.expected: Success(7). Account 7 stores the exact username and hash; matching profile has admin_status=false, a creation timestamp and last_online=NULL. Remaining IDs=[42].

database::users::tests::insert_duplicate.alias: Preserves the existing account and ID pool
database::users::tests::insert_duplicate.input: account(7, "taken", "old-hash"), IDs=[8]; profile admin=true, created 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, last_online 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z; insert_user("taken", "different-hash")
database::users::tests::insert_duplicate.expected: UsernameExists. Account hash, all seeded profile fields, and IDs=[8] remain unchanged.

database::users::tests::insert_max_id.expected: Success(65535); matching account and profile exist and IDs=[].

database::users::tests::insert_full.alias: Creates no rows when IDs are exhausted
database::users::tests::insert_full.expected: NotEnoughSpace; no account or profile row for "new-user".

database::users::tests::insert_profile_e.alias: Rolls back when profile insertion fails
database::users::tests::insert_profile_e.input: IDs=[7], constraint rejects profile username "blocked", insert_user("blocked", "fixture-hash")
database::users::tests::insert_profile_e.expected: HandlerError. Neither row survives and ID 7 remains available.

database::users::removeself_user_tests::.alias: Deletes the account without recycling its ID
database::users::removeself_user_tests::.expected: Success(7). Account and profile 7 are gone. Peers survive and IDs=[10].

database::users::removeself_user_tests::.alias: Preserves rows for a different account's hash
database::users::removeself_user_tests::.expected: WrongCredentials. Accounts, profiles, all messages and IDs are unchanged.

database::users::removeself_user_tests::.input: Remove ("target", "target-hash") successfully from R, then call again with the same values.
database::users::removeself_user_tests::.expected: Second call returns UserNotFound. Peers and IDs=[10] remain unchanged.

database::users::removeself_user_tests::.alias: Uses the recreated account's current hash and ID
database::users::removeself_user_tests::.input: Remove target 7 from R; recreate account(10, "target", "replacement-hash"); call with "target-hash", then "replacement-hash".
database::users::removeself_user_tests::.expected: First call returns WrongCredentials and leaves account 10 intact. Second returns Success(10) and deletes account 10. Neither ID is recycled.

database::users::removeself_user_tests::.input: R plus public messages 11 and 12, remove ("target", "target-hash").
database::users::removeself_user_tests::.expected: Success(7); profile 7 and message 11 are gone. Message 12 survives.

database::users::removeself_user_tests::.input: R plus private messages 21 (7 to 8) and 23 (8 to 9), remove ("target", "target-hash").
database::users::removeself_user_tests::.expected: Success(7); private message 21 is gone. Message 23 survives.

database::users::removeself_user_tests::.input: R plus private messages 22 (8 to 7) and 23 (8 to 9), remove ("target", "target-hash").
database::users::removeself_user_tests::.expected: Success(7); private message 22 is gone. Message 23 survives.

database::users::removeself_user_tests::.alias: Preserves dependents when deletion is blocked
database::users::removeself_user_tests::.input: R plus all messages; a non-cascading foreign key references account 7; remove ("target", "target-hash").
database::users::removeself_user_tests::.expected: HandlerError. All accounts, profiles, messages, and IDs survive.
